rationale: With realistic RC the constraints aren't binding: 'stock' RC runs failed hold or slew/cap, while cap213/orfs runs pass easily (hold +0.09 ns, slew/cap far under bar, 0 DRC). Both best runs (12.63, 12.85) used AREA 3, timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair, cap213 and a tight target; the rest, each missing at least one of these or with very low utilisation, landed at 14.0-20.5. Setting 1 merges the two best: md5's ABC buffering/sizing, post-GRT design repair and ~9 ns target with ocs_blitter's denser floorplan (util 38), plus more slew repair and larger margins. Setting 2 tests an untried DELAY script under that physical recipe; earlier DELAY runs were confounded by weak physical settings.
